subject: The secret feature 90% of users skip
preview_text: One user almost deleted the app. Then they found this. Now it's all they use.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you open an app, poke around, and think meh, I'll figure it out later? Most people do that with SoulPlan. They swipe a few date ideas, maybe save one, then close it. And that's fine. But there's one feature buried so deep most users never find it. And it's the difference between okay dates and unforgettable ones.

Last week, a user named Jake told me he was about to delete the app. He said his girlfriend kept feeling like dates were routine. He tried everything, but nothing stuck. Then he accidentally stumbled into a part of the app he'd never touched. He spent 10 minutes setting it up. The next day, she cried happy tears. He said it was the first time in months she felt truly surprised.

That feature is the shared wishlist. Most couples use the app to browse separately, but the wishlist lets you both drop in date dreams without pressure. You add a rooftop dinner idea. She adds a pottery class. You see each other's picks. It's like a secret language of romance. No awkward conversations. Just pure discovery of what excites you both. And when you're ready to plan, you pick from a list that already has both of your fingerprints on it.

Open SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together right now. Tap the heart icon at the bottom. Create a shared wishlist with your partner. Just one item each. See what happens. P.S. If you don't have a partner yet, add your own dream dates. The app will match you with someone who shares your wishlist vibe. It's the fastest way to find a date who actually gets you.
